_comment: The one generation the stations ran. Only the well was kept from it (stations.py says why).

generations.why: it cut the well's stone into courses; it turned the cold fire's ash to embers and flattened the latrine's boards, so those three ship as drawn
generations.description: row of four survival camp props, top-down 3/4 game sprites, same scale: a round stone well with a wooden windlass, rope and dark water; a wooden plank latrine bench with a hole and its lid up beside a metal bucket; a cold campfire ring of grey stones with charred logs and ash; the same campfire ring with glowing orange embers under the logs; chunky near-black stepped outline, broad flat pixels, 3-4 tones per material, muted desaturated colors
